title: Sorting Fruits Game
description: Sorting Fruits is a relaxing and educational game where players organize colorful fruits into their correct baskets. Theres no timer — just smooth, stress-free gameplay designed to boost focus and sorting skills. With beautiful visuals and easy drag-and-drop controls, it’s a perfect game for kids, families, and casual players. Add Sorting Fruits to your platform and offer your audience a calm, enjoyable gaming experience that improves observation and categorization abilities.
instructions: Mobile Tap on a tube to select it Tap on another tube to pour the top fruit slices Desktop Left Click on a test tube to pick it up Left Click again on another tube to transfer fruits
